profile.headline: Web Application Developer
profile.summary:
-Dean’s List and Honors Society at Purdue College of Science

-Specializes in C# development

-Experience with developing web applications using Classic ASP, ASP.NET, and ASP MVC Frameworks, KnockoutJS, JavaScript, JQuery, C#, Entity Framework, Castle Windsor IoC, 

-Experience with Waterfall, Agile, and Iterative design processes

-Complete application lifecycle experience: Requirements derivation, application design, implementation, dev testing and QA test plan development, long-term maintenance, and sunsetting and/or porting to newer frameworks/design patterns/technologies

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
-Recognized as a subject matter expert for multiple systems and general UI development
-Maintained business-critical Classic ASP applications and oversaw a team of contractors tasked with porting the applications to ASP.NET. Conducted requirements gathering with stakeholders, led the design of the porting approach, and participated in code reviews. Took over the porting effort after the contractors left with the job unfinished. 
-Maintained and performed continuing development work on ASP.NET applications that made heavy use of custom page,session, and permissions framework, along with JavaScript, JQuery, and AJAX.
-Responsible for full application lifecycle of numerous business-critical applications utilizing ASP MVC, Castle Windsor IoC, LINQ, Entity Framework, and KnockoutJS. Developed backends that interface with SQL Server, Oracle 11g, and TeraData databases. Created single-page applications using KnockoutJS and AJAX and traditional MVC applications using multiple strongly-typed Razor Views.
-Responsible for numerous continuing education initiatives: Implemented a Friday Tech Chat to expose the team to new/different technologies. Hosted and developed curriculum for Lunch and Learn sessions to improve the web development skills of team members. Got approval for weekly time off from projects to work on tools and frameworks that will benefit the team and IT as a whole.
-Developed numerous tools and frameworks to benefit the team, including an HTML Builder to replace inline HTML for reports, emails, etc, an implicit logging framework using Castle Windsor and method interception, a custom multiformat XML deserializer, etc.
-Currently developing a Knockout framework that allows a developer to use custom HTMLHelpers and strongly-typed Razor views to output Knockout-enabled HTML. The Knockout viewmodel is created dynamically, and the framework includes utilities that can convert lambda expressions and POCO Properties and method bodies into Knockout compatible JavaScript

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description: Led the development of a business critical web application. Oversaw a team of two associates to design, develop, and implement new solution to a current business need. Coordinated a successful complex production launch involving five plus dependent systems and the migration of two live production databases. Honed web development skills including Windows WCF, ASP.NET MVC Framework, and C# 4.0 Entity Framework. Leveraged Windows TFS Source Control.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Participated in full software life-cycle, from writing requirements to system analysis and design to implementation, testing, and maintenance. Designed and implemented various applications that: increased employee efficiency, discovered purchase order oversights, aided in estimation for purchase orders, and assisted in Win7 transition. Exercised ability to manage multiple projects for several different superiors at one time. Participated in design and technical reviews. Assisted SUIT lead with researching and writing a white paper on Model-based Testing. Gave multiple presentations to various vendors and other business units.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Played key role in early success of multiple department initiatives, including: Created a metrics reporting tool that extracted defect information from a ClearQuest database, created an Excel macro that provided purchase order analysis, created an Excel front-end (distributed across multiple workstations) to log productivity and downtime data for manufacturing process improvement
